name: epsi-pay
description: Plateforme de paiement résiliente - Project RESILIENCE-ALPHA

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix database && npm ci --prefix auth && npm ci --prefix payment && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:generate: npm --prefix database run prisma:generate && npm --prefix auth run prisma:generate && npm --prefix payment run prisma:generate
scripts.build: npm --prefix database run build && npm --prefix auth run build && npm --prefix payment run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f auth payment frontend
scripts.db:setup: docker compose up -d postgres && docker compose up --build database
scripts.k8s:forward: kubectl -n epsi-pay port-forward svc/auth 3001:3000 & kubectl -n epsi-pay port-forward svc/payment 3002:3000 & kubectl -n epsi-pay port-forward svc/frontend 8080:8080 & wait
